issue_request: FHIR-16552 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR-I change request for ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter. The original request asked for apply-status, apply-publisher, and apply-contact boolean parameters, but the accepted resolution changed that to a single repeatable apply parameter whose value names metadata fields including version, date, status, publisher, contact, copyright, experimental, jurisdiction, and useContext.
initial_application: The issue was applied in spreadsheet-era source by 08263bfe9f, which changed the old apply-business-version/apply-jurisdiction code list to a single apply code and added the metadata-field definition. The Jira-commented 6c82a7d4e4 follow-up changed the then-present IG Publisher ConfigFileConverter from specialized apply constants to GuideParameterCode.APPLY with field-name values.
additional_context: Current source no longer uses the old ImplementationGuide spreadsheet and no longer contains the IG Publisher tooling path modified by 6c82a7d4e4. Later source work, especially FHIR-20018 and guide-parameter-code cleanup commits, changed parameter.code to Coding with an extensible binding while preserving the single apply-code semantics. source/fhir.ini actively lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide, confirming the inspected resource folder is in build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. On the current combined branch, ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code is bound to ValueSet/guide-parameter-code, the guide-parameter-code CodeSystem defines code apply, and the definition lists the accepted metadata fields including status, publisher, and contact.
